Sign in to your AutoMoto account

One account on every device: your chats, files and usage time follow you to the Windows app, the web and your phone.

Signed in as on

This device's name

Shown in Account → My devices, where you can sign this device out.

Your password goes once to the server over HTTPS and is never saved. The app keeps a device key in Windows Credential Manager; signing out (or "Sign out" in My devices) cancels it.

Local mode - just this PC

No account. AutoMoto runs on this computer with your own free AI key. Chats and files stay on this PC.

Local mode needs the AutoMoto engine (Python). Install the local engine opens PowerShell and runs the official installer that ships with this app. When it finishes, come back and click Start local mode.

Or run it yourself in PowerShell (from the AutoMotoAI folder):

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1
